target_fidelity.note: It is a present perfect, active, negative declarative with no modal.

grammaticality.note: The target answer is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The prompt and response form a coherent, natural context.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It gives focused practice of the negative present perfect.

determinacy.note: Other equally natural responses, such as “Mia still hasn’t washed the cups” or “Mia has not yet washed the cups,” are not accepted.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and clear.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt does not display the completed target form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: The item can be completed without unrelated advanced grammar.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is required.
